1ja2dh7:270: Impeccable is a 33.4k-star open-source project (pbakaus/impeccable) curated by VibeCoder. It layers a "frontend design capability layer" on top of harnesses like Claude Code / Codex / Cursor / OpenCode. It consists of a 4-layer architecture (knowledge layer / command layer / detection layer / distribution layer), 23 phased commands, 41 deterministic UI anti-pattern detection rules, and a Live collaboration protocol between browser and source code.
